guidance: three.ws is a member of the NVIDIA Inception program, NVIDIA's startup program. Say NVIDIA Inception member and nothing grander: it is not a partnership, a reseller relationship or an investment, and NVIDIA does not endorse or certify three.ws. Talk about what runs on NVIDIA hardware and models, the free hosted lane and the self-hosted GPU fleet, as facts about the stack. Never state credit amounts.

features.title: Avatar voices on NVIDIA Magpie
features.summary: The voice picker offers NVIDIA Magpie multilingual speech as a free lane for any avatar. Speech is synthesized by NVIDIA Riva through a hosted function, with no key needed from the user. Pick the voice, type a line, and the avatar speaks it. The same lane covers many languages.

features.title: A self-hosted GPU fleet on L4 and Blackwell
features.summary: Beyond the free hosted lane, three.ws runs its own fleet of Cloud Run GPU services. Each is a worker wrapping one model, autoscaled per lane. Eleven run on NVIDIA L4 and one runs on an RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell. This is where PBR materials, auto-rigging and motion get made.

features.title: The free NVIDIA model map
features.summary: One NVIDIA API key unlocks the hosted models three.ws uses on its free lane. Text to 3D runs on hosted TRELLIS, avatar voices on Magpie, and the Brain workbench offers Nemotron models. The /nvidia page lays the whole map out in a table. Because the lane is a rate-limited free tier, the platform always keeps a fallback behind it.
